question: Which of the following mountain ranges is NOT a part of the Himalayan mountains?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahadeo Range**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **Mahadeo Range**.
 
• The Mahadeo Range is not a part of the Himalayan mountains.
 
• The Himalayan mountain ranges include the Zanskar Range, Pir Panjal Range, and Karakoram Range.
